text: Lefina has lost her memory while making sweets.\nFilecia says she can make a potion to cure her.\nCollect the ingredients to restore her memory!
After you tell Filecia about Adonius, she asks you to take\nher to him. But you only find a suspicious researcher who\nsuddenly summons a monster. Defeat Erkuch!
[[N]]Gather the ingredients for the potion in Farkoma Forest
